scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w @capitales/desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start -w @capitales/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run package -w @capitales/desktop
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:desktop && npm run package:linux -w @capitales/desktop
scripts.build:android: npm run build:single && npm run sync -w @capitales/android
scripts.package:android: npm run build:android && npm run apk -w @capitales/android
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:single
